title: 9th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/2024).
Preliminary debate on the State Fiscal Responsibility Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Thulusdhoo MP Ibrahim Naseem.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the State Debt Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to open debate on the government's Fiscal Responsibility Bill and continue the debate on the State Debt Bill.
